answer: Stop sybils with a copper crystal harbor: an agent bonds one harbor slip. Each cycle it sets one copper float carrying a crystal lens; verifiers match the lens beam to the slip chart, voiding a copied float, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 slips at 18x: one lens refracts once at one harbor, its beam set by that water, unrepeatable at a second, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents set once, keep rights.
